soundness_flags.label: ass:cic-identification / def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited CiC paper formulates its identification theorem on proper convex subsets of R^d, not a flat-torus periodic-lift model; retag this as a novel model and justify/prove the transfer, or formulate the project on the cited Euclidean support class.

soundness_flags.label: def:multiplier-ellipses and thm:simultaneous-ellipses
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed ellipses and multiplier critical value use (Vhat_adj,jj)^(-1), but Vhat_adj is only defined as positive semidefinite, so these objects are undefined on singular finite samples; specify a ridge/generalized inverse or a measurable fallback.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published identification result assumes observable and counterfactual measures supported on proper convex subsets of R^d and identifies the Brenier trend/counterfactual map under those Euclidean-support assumptions; it does not state a periodic flat-torus specialization.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the asserted periodic-lift inheritance with a self-contained torus CiC identification lemma, or move the analysis to the published convex-domain model and derive the required boundary treatment; state exactly which causal-model membership properties are preserved by the Green alternatives.
Make inference total by defining a ridge-regularized covariance inverse and prove the ridge is asymptotically negligible, or define an explicit singular-matrix fallback confidence set.

Promote the explicit four-cell covariance formula into a sharp comparison against both the one-map critical CLT and a named CiC inference comparator, with a nonconstant-coefficient worked instance showing the generated-target cross contribution is nonzero.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal-model foundation and finite-sample covariance inversion, then retain the field-tier nested critical-CLT and local-minimax kernel for Stage 0.
